section.title: Everything You Need to Know Before Starting Your Project
section.description: We've answered the most common questions about pricing, timelines, development, support, and our workflow. If you still have questions, our team is always happy to help.

general-why-novyra.question: Why should I choose Novyra Technologies?
general-why-novyra.answer: We build websites, applications, and AI-powered solutions engineered for speed, scale, and real business results.

general-industries.question: Which industries do you work with?
general-industries.answer: We work with healthcare, education, SaaS, eCommerce, startups, finance, logistics, and many other industries. Every solution is customized to match your business goals instead of using one-size-fits-all templates.

general-process.question: How does the project process work?
general-process.answer: Every project follows Discovery → Planning → Design → Development → Testing → Launch → Support. You'll receive regular updates throughout the project, so you always know what's happening.

general-international.question: Can you work with international clients?
general-international.answer: Yes. We work remotely with clients from anywhere in the world. Meetings, project tracking, and communication are handled online for a smooth collaboration experience.

general-nda.question: Do you sign NDAs?
general-nda.answer: Yes. We can sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement before starting your project. Your business ideas, documents, and sensitive information remain private and secure.

pricing-cost.question: How much does a project cost?
pricing-cost.answer: The price depends on your project's size, features, and overall complexity. After understanding your requirements, we'll provide a detailed and transparent quotation.

pricing-custom.question: Why is pricing custom?
pricing-custom.answer: Every project differs in scope, integrations, and features, so the final quote depends on your specific requirements. The figures above are accurate starting points for each tier, refined into a fixed quote after a free consultation.

pricing-consultation-free.question: Is the consultation free?
pricing-consultation-free.answer: Yes. Your first consultation is completely free. We'll discuss your goals, recommend the right solution, and answer your questions without any obligation.

pricing-hidden-charges.question: Are there any hidden charges?
pricing-hidden-charges.answer: No. We believe in complete pricing transparency. Everything included in your project is clearly mentioned before development begins.

pricing-milestones.question: Can I pay in milestones?
pricing-milestones.answer: Yes. Most projects follow milestone-based payments. This keeps the process transparent and ensures you only pay as work progresses.

pricing-upgrade.question: Can I upgrade my package later?
pricing-upgrade.answer: Absolutely. Additional features can be added anytime. Your website or application can grow as your business grows.

dev-tech-stack.question: Which technologies do you use?
dev-tech-stack.answer: We use React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, GraphQL, AWS, Docker, and more. We always choose modern, reliable technologies that are suitable for your project.

dev-responsive.question: Will my website be mobile responsive?
dev-responsive.answer: Yes. Every website is optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop devices. Your visitors will enjoy a smooth experience on every screen size.

dev-custom-software.question: Do you build custom software?
dev-custom-software.answer: Yes. Every project is built specifically for your business. We don't rely on generic templates for custom solutions.

dev-admin-dashboards.question: Do you provide admin dashboards?
dev-admin-dashboards.answer: Yes. We develop secure and easy-to-use admin panels. You'll be able to manage content, users, and business data without technical knowledge.

dev-api-integrations.question: Can you integrate third-party APIs?
dev-api-integrations.answer: Yes. We integrate payment gateways, CRMs, AI services, analytics, and many other APIs. Your software can easily connect with the tools your business already uses.

support-post-launch.question: Do you provide post-launch support?
support-post-launch.answer: Yes. Every project includes post-launch support. We'll help with bug fixes, updates, and technical assistance after launch.

support-response-time.question: How quickly do you respond?
support-response-time.answer: Our internal target is to respond to support requests within 24 hours, with critical issues prioritized first.

support-maintain-existing.question: Can you maintain my existing website?
support-maintain-existing.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance for websites built by us or by other developers. We can improve performance, security, and add new features whenever needed.

support-monitoring.question: Do you offer website monitoring?
support-monitoring.answer: Yes. Monitoring services are available with our maintenance plans. We can monitor uptime, performance, and security to keep your website running smoothly.

support-new-features.question: Can I request new features later?
support-new-features.answer: Absolutely. Your project is designed to be scalable, making future improvements simple and efficient.

seo-included.question: Is SEO included?
seo-included.answer: Yes. Every website is built following technical SEO best practices. This helps search engines understand your website more effectively.

seo-google.question: Will my website be optimized for Google?
seo-google.answer: Yes. We optimize performance, metadata, structured data, and Core Web Vitals. A well-optimized website has a better chance of ranking higher in search results.

seo-speed.question: Do you improve website speed?
seo-speed.answer: Yes. Performance optimization is included in every project. Fast-loading websites improve user experience and SEO.

seo-ongoing.question: Do you provide ongoing SEO services?
seo-ongoing.answer: Yes. Monthly SEO plans are available. We can help improve rankings, traffic, and website visibility over time.

seo-migration.question: Can you migrate my website without losing SEO?
seo-migration.answer: Yes. We follow safe migration practices. Proper redirects and SEO planning help protect your existing search rankings.

ai-integrate.question: Can you integrate AI into my website?
ai-integrate.answer: Yes. We build AI-powered features and automation. AI can improve customer support, productivity, and business efficiency.

ai-models.question: Which AI models do you support?
ai-models.answer: We work with OpenAI, Claude, Google Gemini, and other modern AI platforms. We select the model that fits your use case.

ai-automate.question: Can AI automate business tasks?
ai-automate.answer: Yes. AI can automate repetitive work such as customer support, lead qualification, reporting, and content generation.

ai-saas.question: Do you build AI SaaS products?
ai-saas.answer: Yes. We develop complete AI-powered SaaS platforms. From idea to deployment, we can build scalable AI applications tailored to your business.

ai-secure.question: Is AI secure?
ai-secure.answer: Yes. We follow industry best practices for security and privacy. Sensitive data is protected using secure authentication and encrypted communication.

integrations-payment.question: Which payment gateways do you support?
integrations-payment.answer: We integrate Stripe, Razorpay, PayPal, Cashfree, and other providers. The payment gateway is selected based on your target market and business requirements.

integrations-crm-erp.question: Can you connect my CRM or ERP?
integrations-crm-erp.answer: Yes. We integrate popular CRM and ERP platforms. This helps centralize customer information and automate business processes.

integrations-analytics.question: Do you integrate analytics tools?
integrations-analytics.answer: Yes. We support Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Microsoft Clarity, Mixpanel, and more. These tools help you understand visitor behavior and measure business growth.

integrations-notifications.question: Can you integrate email and notification services?
integrations-notifications.answer: Yes. We integrate email, SMS, WhatsApp, and push notification services. Automated notifications help improve customer communication and engagement.

integrations-apis.question: Can you connect my software with third-party APIs?
integrations-apis.answer: Yes. We build secure REST API, GraphQL, and webhook integrations. This allows your application to communicate seamlessly with external services and business tools.

infoPanel.description: Our team is available to discuss your project requirements, recommend the right solution, and answer any technical or business questions.
